_comment: Digest lockfile for the Bazel rules_oci runner images (ADR 0010, KUBE PLAN SLICE-23). Every consumer (shards, merge job, pre-pull) pulls by the digest recorded here, never by tag. Built/pushed via tools/runners/push-runner-images.sh; verified by tools/runners/verify_lockfile.py.

merge.note: Real merge runner, tools verified executable. Report-merge adapter bodies arrive in SLICE-27.

python.tools: pytest 9.1.0 + ruff 0.8.6 + mypy 1.13.0 + coverage 7.14.1 + bandit 1.9.4 + mutmut 3.5.0
python.note: rules_python hermetic 3.12 wheels (toolbox.py runpy dispatcher) + ruff standalone binary. All six tools verified runnable via 'toolbox <tool>'.

rust.note: clippy added as the version-matched rustup component (cargo-clippy + clippy-driver) with LD_LIBRARY_PATH to the base toolchain libs. All four verified runnable.

node-browser.note: Built via rules_js js_image_layer (preserves the rules_js symlink store so Node module resolution works in-image) + a //frontend:runner_toolbox launcher that resolves each tool through its package 'bin' field (rules_js does not materialise node_modules/.bin). Node pinned 20.17.0 because the frontend deps need node:util.styleText (>=20.17.0). All four tools verified runnable. Playwright e2e browser is a follow-on layer.
